families.title: Two checkout submissions for one cart
families.demonstrates: One business payment intent; the module creates no second operation.

results.title: Shopper taps Pay twice; the kiosk sends the same request id
results.expectation: 1 checkout, 1 debit, 1 order

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: On PGlite the two calls are serialized. The concurrent version runs on a Postgres server in tests/postgres_test.ts.

results.title: Two submissions arrive at the same moment
results.expectation: 1 checkout, 1 debit, 1 order

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: PGlite has one connection; this sequence is only meaningful on a server.

results.title: Same kiosk request id reused with a different cart at the same price, then with another saved bank reference
results.expectation: Both refused: the id is bound to a fingerprint of the whole intent
notes: Before this check, a different cart at the same total silently joined the first checkout.

families.title: Provider accepted, response lost, worker crashed
families.demonstrates: Recovery with the original identity, or an explicit unresolved state.

results.title: Bank accepts the capture; the response never arrives
results.expectation: Retry sends the same key; 1 debit

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: The simulated provider returns the original result for a repeated key. That guarantee is listed as to confirm per provider.

results.title: Bank accepts; the worker dies before writing the result; a second worker resumes
results.expectation: Same operation row, same key; 1 debit

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: The lease expired after 60 s; the reclaim is in the event journal.

results.title: Same crash, but the provider cannot deduplicate a repeated key
results.expectation: Not repeated; a person is asked to look

module.reason: A previous capture attempt may have reached the bank, and this provider cannot deduplicate a repeat. Not repeated. Check the provider dashboard before any retry.

notes: The money moved and the register shows the order unpaid. The module stops rather than guess; the correct ending is a person checking the provider dashboard.

families.title: Duplicate, missing, reordered and invalid webhooks
families.demonstrates: Invalid input rejected; repeats do not repeat effects; a lost notice is found by reading the bank, for 60 days after settlement.

results.title: Every webhook delivered twice
results.expectation: Settlement recorded once

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: Delivery results: recorded, duplicate_event.

results.title: Return notice arrives before the settlement notice
results.expectation: Both recorded; net is the same in either order

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R01). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: Delivery results: recorded, recorded.
Goods were handed over, then the debit came back R01: the store is short and staff are told.

results.title: Settlement webhook never arrives
results.expectation: The reconciler polls the provider and records it

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: Recorded with source 'poll'; a late webhook for the same fact inserts nothing.

results.title: Forged, tampered and stale webhooks
results.expectation: All rejected; nothing recorded

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: forged: rejected_signature, tampered: rejected_signature, stale: rejected_signature, unsigned: rejected_signature.

results.title: Goods handed over; an R10 comes back on day 20 and its notice is lost
results.expectation: The reconciler keeps reading the bank for 60 days and finds it

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R10). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: Settled captures stay on the reconciler's list until 60 days after settlement, the consumer return window for R05, R07, R10 and R11.

results.title: Settlement notice lost, return notice delivered
results.expectation: The settlement is read from the bank's history, not invented; the store is short $97.50, not $195

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R01). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: Before reconciliation the ledger showed the store short 195.00; after reading the bank, 97.50.

results.title: R10 dated day 59, notice lost, every bank read failing from day 59 to day 70
results.expectation: Found on day 71: the watch closes only after a successful read past the window

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R10). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: An age cutoff would have dropped this capture after day 60. The watch closes only after a successful read at least 65 days after settlement (60-day window plus a 5-day reporting margin).

families.title: Payment approved, order rejected or unknown
families.demonstrates: No instruction to pay again; bounded escalation without fictitious success.

results.title: Register rejects the order after the shopper approved payment
results.expectation: Nothing captured; preauthorization voided

module.reason: The register rejected the order: Item GUM-100 not in the selling room. Nothing was captured.

notes: The naive baseline debits first and reports the order complete on the 202, although the register never created a usable order.

results.title: Order submission times out; the register has no record yet
results.expectation: Status checked by our GUID, resubmitted with the same GUID; 1 order

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: Resubmitting under the same GUID assumes Cova treats it as the same order. To confirm with Cova.

results.title: Register never confirms the order
results.expectation: Nothing captured; staff alerted after 5 minutes

module.reason: The register has not confirmed order a4bdf6d5-0b68-4980-a318-499eeea8033a after 5 minutes. Nothing was captured.

notes: The preauthorization is left in place for staff to decide; no funds moved.

results.title: Cashier cancels the order between capture and the payment record
results.expectation: Paid, order cancelled: refund decision for staff, no automatic refund

module.reason: Paid by bank ($97.50, pay_0002) but the order was cancelled at the register. A refund decision is needed. Nothing was refunded automatically.

notes: A fixed-delay automatic refund would be unsafe here: the shopper may be standing at the counter.

results.title: Order submission reaches the register, response lost
results.expectation: Status read under our GUID finds it; 1 order

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

results.title: Same fault as 4b, on a register not confirmed to deduplicate by order id
results.expectation: Not re-sent; a person checks the register; nothing captured

module.reason: The register has no record of order fb5bedbb-0770-40dc-a4d4-4b15abc0282f after a submission that timed out, and re-sending under the same id is not confirmed safe for this POS. Nothing was captured. Check the register before retrying.

notes: The same capability gate the bank has: without confirmed deduplication, a timed-out submission is not replayed.

families.title: Order exists, register does not show it paid
families.demonstrates: A visible mismatch, not a green completed result.

results.title: Register refuses the payment record
results.expectation: Staff told: paid by bank, do not collect again

module.reason: Paid by bank ($97.50, pay_0002). The register does not show the payment (status: PaymentCannotBeApplied: Payment type not configured for this location). Do not collect again at the counter.

notes: The register still shows the order unpaid, so a cashier could collect again: yes. The module cannot prevent that; it can only say it loudly.
The naive baseline never records payment at the register at all.

results.title: Payment record reached the register, response lost
results.expectation: Applied once; a paid status alone does not prove it is ours

module.reason: The register shows a payment, but this response does not establish whether it is our bank payment (pay_0002, $97.50 accepted by the bank). Check the payment record before handing over or refunding.

notes: Cova's documented status says the order is paid, not by whom. Without a payment-reference lookup the module cannot tell our record from another payment, so it asks a person (see 5e for the same fault with a lookup).

results.title: Staff try to hand over before the register shows payment
results.expectation: Refused without a written reason

module.reason: Paid by bank ($97.50, pay_0002). The register does not show the payment (status: PaymentCannotBeApplied: Payment type not configured for this location). Do not collect again at the counter.

notes: Without reason: register_has_not_acknowledged_payment. With reason: accepted and journaled.

results.title: Bank capture accepted, and meanwhile the cashier takes cash and records it at the register
results.expectation: Not marked paid: possible double collection, a person checks

module.reason: The register shows a payment, but this response does not establish whether it is our bank payment (pay_0002, $97.50 accepted by the bank). Check the payment record before handing over or refunding.

notes: Our payment record is refused because the order is already paid; the register's status alone would say paid. The module reads the refusal as a warning, not as success.

results.title: Same fault as 5b, with a register that lists payments with their references
results.expectation: Our reference and amount found: paid

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: Cova's documented status does not carry the payment reference. Whether another endpoint does is a discovery question.

results.title: Our payment record never arrives, then the cashier records cash
results.expectation: Not called paid: possible double collection

module.reason: The register shows a payment, but this response does not establish whether it is our bank payment (pay_0002, $97.50 accepted by the bank). Check the payment record before handing over or refunding.

notes: Before this fix, a paid status after a lost record was read as our payment.

results.title: Our payment record succeeds, the worker dies, the replay is refused as already paid
results.expectation: Escalated without claiming who paid

module.reason: The register shows a payment, but this response does not establish whether it is our bank payment (pay_0002, $97.50 accepted by the bank). Check the payment record before handing over or refunding.

notes: Only our payment is at the register, but the refusal alone cannot prove it; with a payment lookup this would be recovered.

families.title: Final total changes, or cancellation is unavailable
families.demonstrates: No unauthorized amount change and no assumed compensation.

results.title: Register total is $6.00 higher than the kiosk quote
results.expectation: Nothing captured above the approved amount; new approval needed

module.reason: The register total is $102.00 plus the $1.50 fee, above the $97.50 the shopper approved. Ask the shopper to approve the new total. Nothing was captured.

notes: Capturing more than the shopper approved is how an R11 return starts.

results.title: Register total is $2.40 lower (a sale price applied)
results.expectation: Capture the lower total, never the quote

module.reason: Paid. The register shows our bank payment.

notes: Captured 9510 cents: register total plus the fee. That a provider lets you capture less than the preauthorization is to confirm.

results.title: Preauthorization expires before capture
results.expectation: Capture declined; unpaid order cancelled; nothing charged

module.reason: The bank declined the capture (preauth_expired). Nothing was captured; the unpaid order is being cancelled.

results.title: Capture declined and the register refuses to cancel the unpaid order
results.expectation: Staff told; nothing assumed

module.reason: Unpaid order a0b92e7c-2021-4a65-b77f-bce35c595831 could not be cancelled (inventory already allocated). Nothing was captured.

notes: Refusal text modeled on Dutchie's documented rule (no cancel with allocated inventory); Cova documents cancel for unpaid orders.

families.title: Refund races a bank return, including after a restart
families.demonstrates: Both outcomes recorded; no duplicate refund initiated locally; exposure stays visible.

results.title: Goods returned and refunded; the original debit also comes back R10
results.expectation: Three movements kept; store is short by the full amount

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R10). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: Plaid documents this case publicly: a refunded debit can still be returned, and the merchant is debited for both. Who bears it is set by the provider contract.

results.title: An R01 return dated on its deadline, whose notice reaches us four days later
results.expectation: Recorded; flagged as a late notice, not as a late return

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R01). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: Deadline for R01 after a 2026-09-29 settlement: 2026-10-01; the return is dated 2026-10-01, the notice arrived 2026-10-05. A late notice and a late return are different facts; both would be kept.

results.title: Return arrives first; staff then try to refund
results.expectation: Refund refused locally: the debit is already returned

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R01). Money was taken back from the store.

notes: Refund request: debit_already_returned.

results.title: Two staff members press Refund; the first worker dies after the bank accepted
results.expectation: One refund operation, one refund at the bank

module.reason: Refunded $97.50 (rf_0004). Not for pickup.

notes: Partial and multiple refunds are outside this slice.

results.title: Refund accepted, worker dies, the refund settles and its notice arrives before we wrote the reference
results.expectation: Notice refused for retry, not swallowed; the refund is recorded

module.reason: Refunded $97.50 (rf_0004). Not for pickup.

notes: Early notice: unknown_reference (the HTTP handler answers 503 so the provider retries); the reconciler also reads accepted refunds.

results.title: Register work delayed by an outage; the debit settles and comes back R01; then the register shows paid
results.expectation: Stays with staff; ordinary handoff refused

module.reason: Bank returned the debit (R01). The register status does not clear it.

notes: Ordinary handoff: financial_exception_on_record. A later register reading no longer overwrites a known return.

results.title: Order refunded before pickup
results.expectation: Closed, not ready for pickup; ordinary handoff refused

module.reason: Refunded $97.50 (rf_0003). Not for pickup.

notes: Ordinary handoff: financial_exception_on_record.

families.title: Saved reference of another shopper or store, or a revoked connection
families.demonstrates: Access denied or reauthentication required; no debit under an unrelated identity.

results.title: Checkout with another shopper's saved bank reference
results.expectation: Refused before any bank call
notes: The naive baseline debits shopper B's bank for shopper A's cart.

results.title: Saved reference registered at a different store
results.expectation: Refused

results.title: Bank connection revoked, then the shopper checks out
results.expectation: Reauthentication required

results.title: Connection revoked at the bank between preauthorization and capture
results.expectation: No debit; order cancelled; shopper asked to reconnect

module.reason: The shopper's bank connection was revoked before capture. Nothing was captured; the unpaid order is being cancelled.
